task: Independent read-only review of root's single backward private preserve allocation OOM control

runtime.qualification: Existing numerical qualification is unchanged; this review establishes no new native OOM result.

resource_parent.note: The new driver loads the immutable original module, verifies its complete source manifest, final runtime/build/image and all 13 source/object files before creating a Session. No original resource recipe is rerun by this review.

findings.detail: The test constructs an actual rank-one requires-grad F32 leaf x of N=65536, actual 114(x, original binary64 1.0), and actual 111 stride-2 seed from a non-grad 2N backing. The live owner guards rank/shape/stride/dtype/require flags, op0 leaf, op3 output, one enabled parent edge, original rank-zero dtype3 scalar, no retained or ViewInfo path, existing gradient root/incarnation and zero scratch fields. It does not emulate Tensor mutation in Python.

partial_admit and the direct-root history path admit this fixed graph without an extent allocation. partial_mark uses the existing history queue. history_prepare_leaf finds the actual existing G at descriptor +384 and does not call gradient_new. With live T row, history_accumulator_target returns zero. The guard xn<yn places this leaf before output in ascending ensure_backward_work.

partial_execute allocates 24+16*(highest+1)+8*(highest+1)+gradient_workspace_size. Here highest+1=state.next. The only nonleaf is op3 with two parent slots but only one enabled N-element leaf; gradient_workspace_size contributes 8+32*2+5*N=72+5*N. Therefore align16(24+24*state.next+72+5*N) is the actual first extent size. Recomputing after every filler accounts for new descriptors.

After workspace, ensure_backward_work invokes incoming_mark_preserve_targets, traverses marked nodes in increasing index, obtains no new leaf G, allocates leaf normal 4*N at +256, reserves one Version row, then invokes incoming_reserve_preserve_storage for marker +544. This occurs before the output normal buffer and before retained_reserve. The wrapped op3/right-original-dtype3/side0 marker is an actual final07b path.

dview_preserve_capacity begins at 4*leaf.numel and only enlarges for active op44 geometry targeting that leaf. This graph contains no enabled op44; the target is exactly align16(4*N)=262144. A noncontiguous seed is constructed and guarded; this review does not claim every backward result must itself remain noncontiguous.

slot_headroom decodes dead rows with generation<4294967295, matching so_slot_available. At least eight reusable slots in kinds 1,2,3,6 exceeds pretarget workspace+normal Storage/Hold pairs and one Version. Existing page0 and state.next<240 prevent descriptor-page growth; the actual path creates no new leaf-gradient descriptor before the target.

State.free decodes the ordered actual free extents and Case.mark validates the full extent partition. consume_extent_budget aligns16, selects the first fitting entry, removes exact fits or consumes the prefix exactly as so_extent_allocate. Setup requires workspace and normal buffer each fit and the total remaining free bytes is below the target. This is stronger than merely failing a largest-extent test. Any failed setup guard leaves the control FAIL rather than claiming target isolation.

Actual owners.hepta 9c02... performs a 5056-byte buffer.try_new scratch, then make_trial of the current owner size, then entry. On error3 with larger capacity hint it drops the unsuccessful trial before attempting a larger clone. An unsuccessful new owner returns the original owner after dropping its trial. storage_capacity signals the increased pool through +56; slot guards exclude table growth.

The headroom permits page(current_owner+16)+page(5056+16)+65536 above observed VmSize, while requiring that even the page-rounded enlarged owner alone exceed that headroom. The ordinary cmd94 control uses the same one-command frame and same owner-capacity transaction under the limit. The fixed source order and free-extent proof distinguish the preserve-triggered capacity hint; error3 alone is not accepted. The actual OS allocation, rollback and retry outcomes remain unexecuted by this review.

Actual wrapped_scalar_08 gradient_object_command dispatches 94 through resolve_handle to retained_query. retained_query validates public_node then calls retained_enabled; retained_enabled/retained_row read the live Tensor row and retained flag and allocate nothing on the valid path. For this plain leaf with no retain, it returns zero. This is not zero_grad and does not erase the existing G or consume an owner extent.

Inherited Case.refusal requires header error3 with no records, exact before/after owner dictionary including pointer,length,live and all bytes, complete RNG equality, and exact /proc maps. Case.mark then runs strict committed84Q and extent partition checks. The temporary child limit restores in finally. Native audit53=1, unchanged source/seed/canary bytes, exact identical 58 retry, actual pool growth, existing G node/incarnation retention, reset/drop and EOF are required.

Python computes resource sizes, decodes actual owner fields and transports literal commands. The only fixed scalar is read from the admitted original positive_one row. No expected output or gradient value is synthesized. Recovery is explicitly resource/ownership integrity; separate original76 numerical qualification is neither repeated nor expanded.

source02_correction.known_original_problem: The final complete-owned-child-EOF guard could raise before writing top-level report.json.
source02_correction.conclusion: Only three finalization lines become four report-update lines. All geometry, allocation simulation, limits, commands, comparisons, run_case and original module loading are byte-identical. EOF failure remains FAIL and can now be persisted.

limits: Source-only review; no native OOM or restore/retry result is asserted.
The attribution is a fixed-source plus live-owner precondition proof, not an instruction trace claiming to directly observe the internal failing allocation.
No independent compatibility oracle or whole-PyTorch gate is added.
The original verify_isolated_transition exclusion is not relaxed; committed84Q validation and exact failure rollback are the stated owner scope.
Valid setup and same-capacity control must actually succeed under the eventual root execution; if either fails the test must remain FAIL.

tools.read_failures_preserved: Bounded h_view refused the >1 MiB runtime even with a content search. Smaller actual source units were subsequently read. Transient SSH read failures were read retries only; no process was started or reissued.

decision: No additional substantive source blocker was identified in the reviewed test. Root remains the sole writer and future native executor.
